metadata.title: Length-convexity and domination for Hitchin representations
metadata.abstract: Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus $g\geq 2$. For any $n\geq 3$, let $\text{Hit}_n(S)$ be the Hitchin component and let $\text{Hit}_n(S)^\prime$ be the subset of representations that take values in $\mathrm{PSp}_{2m}(\mathbb{R})$ if $n=2m$ and $\mathrm{PSO}(m,m+1)$ if $n=2m+1$. In this note we prove that for any Hitchin representation $\rho \in \text{Hit}_n(S)$ there is $j \in \text{Hit}_n(S)^\prime$ such that $\rho$ dominates $j$ in the Hilbert length spectrum; this confirms a conjecture of Lee-Zhang and, independently, Tholozan who had proved this for $n=3$. The key step is establishing a convexity of the Hilbert length function in the Bonahon-Dreyer parametrization of $\text{Hit}_n(S)$; this uses a result from the recent work of Barman-Gupta. We also prove these convexity and domination results for translation length functions and their spectra.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明任意 Hitchin 表示的 Hilbert 长度谱支配一个取值于相应实辛群或分裂正交群的 Hitchin 表示，确认 Lee–Zhang 与 Tholozan 的猜想，并处理平移长度谱。
analysis.breakthrough: 把已知三维表示结论推广到任意 n≥3。
analysis.limitations: 支配针对所述长度函数和特定子群，不代表任意几何量或表示的全序关系。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者将对数谱半径凸性和主定理中 Brouwer 不动点方法两项关键想法明确归因于 ChatGPT 5.6 Sol，随后由作者验证并独立撰文；ChatGPT 6 Astra 仅作最后编辑检查。

analysis.priorityReason: 高阶 Teichmüller 理论中具体而一般的长度谱比较结果。
